## Problem and behavior

A task whose failed or cancelled attempt is known to have finished needs an explicit recovery path. `task-budget-resume` admits that transition against the current budget digest, preserving original effort, deadline, repetition counts and attempt history. It dispatches nothing; the next attempt requires fresh admission. Active or uncertain work remains denied.

This advances G-01b/G-02a and POAM-009. It does not extend budgets, resolve unknown provider outcomes or execute project-file changes. Version remains 1.0.0.

## Integration and source review

Connectome's Tasks workspace is the production consumer. Native worker PR229 landed as `f4d74af4861e8f2f008e3c3bd8fcb4e1503c0294`; Connectome PR28 landed as `1032dd05e536e98f7b69eb55bdd64129a7472c31`, each after its protected checks passed. Native PR230 precedes UI PR29 and UI PR30. Discovery is already on main.

The ordinary merge is now committed as `a99d577aedcf05c9dc435114912ee666a6d0875b`, tree `8208acbfca35de2a2bbe83a2d63d47ef1bd1933f`. All 22 conflicts are resolved. Independent review and staged-tree verification preserve 54 resume-only and 455 landing-only paths. The combined canonical catalogue contains all 79 landed operations plus resume, with generated SDKs and OpenAPI digest `e6bd6b60e12398a5ee5ddaf23f846e74288bc128f91acc561d9099381072d80f`.

Review caught and corrected an initial whole-file resolution that dropped the resume descriptor and request-schema arm. The linked journal preserves that failure, source review, toolchain corrections and validation. No incoming runtime modules or historical receipts were removed or relabeled.

## Validation and remaining acceptance

- Focused worker/resume, native HTTP effort, catalogue and observation checks: 20 passed.
- Engine all-feature/all-target suite: 419 passed; four explicit subprocess/privileged fixtures ignored as documented.
- Contract/server/client all-feature/all-target suites: 240 passed, none ignored.
- Six-language real-daemon conformance passed; rerun verified pinned .NET SDK 10.0.402, Node 24.22.0 and pnpm 12.14.0 after identifying the earlier .NET toolchain mismatch.
- Strict Clippy, formatting, generated surfaces, TypeScript lint/typecheck/seven tests/generation check, documentation, navigation and execution inventory passed.
- Four unchanged incoming CRLF evidence files retain their original blobs; scoped whitespace checks pass.

The parent SWAG session owns final integration. A clean source-bound binary is building for the existing installed recovery driver. Fresh actual terminal rejection, same-task resume, new selection/worker, preserved original records/deadline, replay denial and independent credential-free readback are still required. Historical `6a4cbb04`/`ce20dc79` live evidence does not qualify this candidate. Keep this PR draft until the fresh trial and linked evidence are complete, then require full candidate and protected CI.

[Current reconciliation journal](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/codex/task-budget-resume/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-budget-resume-current-worker.md) records scope, commands, failures and remaining boundaries. [Historical implementation](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/codex/task-budget-resume/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-budget-resume.md) and [proof harness](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/codex/task-budget-resume/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-budget-resume-proof.md) retain their source identities.

## Limits and stop conditions

Existing engine transactions, receipts and public contracts remain the only authorities. No new external algorithm, routing policy or telemetry ledger is introduced. Ordinary-edit UI replanning, source-grounded context, governed project effects, independently reviewed learning and native binary/score/choice assessment cycles remain unfinished.

Stop on changed scope, lost lineage, failed checks, unknown external outcomes or altered original budget/history. The previously policy-rejected optional restart of an existing desktop engine will not be retried or counted as evidence; a fresh trial manages only its own children. No quality, loaded-weight identity, serving-memory or distribution qualification is claimed.
title: Resume safely stopped task budgets without resetting effort
